measurement_procedure: For each agent, look up federation_member via accord_public_keys.key_id prefix-match on agent_id_hash. Fraction of non-members in the cohort. Threshold above which federation participation is judged uneven.

threshold_function.concern_direction_semantics: Consumer emits negative-scored attestation when metric is at-or-above threshold_value. Single-pole concern: low values at this axis are not a failure mode (see rationale).
threshold_function.rationale: nonmember_frac high = uneven federation (rigidity-pole concern). Low (everyone member) is not a failure mode at this axis — forced-membership is a different signal at a different axis.

notes: A score of −0.4 indicates uneven participation; magnitude scales above threshold.
